River Rubbernecker 🚢 watches live ship tracking on any big river or harbor and texts you when a big tanker, container ship or bulker is about to pass your spot. Then it sends 60- and 30-minute countdowns. Mine watches the Delaware in Philly. Grab it: https://t.co/vazV3d20BV… https://t.co/noZHDkIyW0

— John Solly (@_jsolly) September 25, 2026
